Whether the OOB-read values (bEndpointAddress, bInterval, wMaxPacketSize) in the reported findings can be escalated beyond probe-time crash/DoS (e.g. mis-sized buffers later overflowed) was not traced beyond the immediate pipe-programming and buffer-sizing uses named in the reasons.
limitations: Findings are hypotheses based on static reading of probe/bind code paths; no device or emulator was used to demonstrate the OOB read, and the exact slab layout past an empty endpoint flex-array (NULL-page fault vs adjacent-memory read) depends on allocation internals.

The hwa-rc.c and i1480/dfu/usb.c findings are medium confidence because the exact ordering of the endpoint reads relative to probe completion (immediate vs deferred radio-controller/firmware start) was not fully traced within this session.
